people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Nahash
people.line: Ammonite king, father of Hanun, showed kindness to David.

translations.web: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: Some time later, Nahash king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son.
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
